response.rationale: Fever, conjunctivitis, elevated inflammatory markers, and confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection meet MIS-C criteria; the cerebral stenoses and brain lesions are neurological complications of the systemic inflammatory process, not a primary vasculitis or AHLE.
